app.name: ScummVM (RPX test)
app.coder: ScummVM Team; Wii U port by Rrhapsod
app.long_description: Experimental Wii U Homebrew Launcher package. This is the same executable shipped inside the matching Aroma WUHB, not a separately validated legacy port. Requires a launcher and loader with RPX support. Non-Aroma startup, SD access, audio, input, keyboard and exit behavior need testing. See the included README for this build's engine list and validation status. Games and MT-32 ROMs are not included. Back up configuration and saves before testing. See README-RPX.md and report the exact environment and launcher version at https://github.com/Rrhapsod/scummvm-wiiu/issues.
